subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Control UI for Multi-Agent + Subagent Orchestration (Hierarchy, Bulk Ops, and Scalability)

question: Should #52803 be a dedicated runtime subagent orchestration surface, an expansion of Sessions/Tasks/Workboard, or deferred behind the modular dashboard roadmap?
rationale: The feature gap is clear in current source, but code inspection cannot choose the durable UI owner or the safety model for privileged bulk run controls.

options.title: Stage read-only hierarchy first
options.body: Approve a first slice that renders existing session/task lineage and active/failed/completed state without adding bulk mutations yet.

options.title: Fold into an existing surface
options.body: Make Sessions, Tasks, or Workboard own this workflow to avoid another route, accepting that one existing model will need to absorb orchestration semantics.

options.title: Defer to dashboard roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical context while #101145 and #101151 settle the modular dashboard structure.

recommendation.title: Stage read-only hierarchy first
recommendation.body: Approve a first slice that renders existing session/task lineage and active/failed/completed state without adding bulk mutations yet.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested UI depends heavily on the session lifecycle, subagent metadata, and steering API substrate from PR #50101.
